registration.stage: fixed exploratory screen; not a production qualification
registration.baseline: current adopted v10 A19 combat, locked V3 doctrine draft, adopted contextual draft, ranged setup and final placement v2
registration.selection: first public Abomination offer with another offered choice per three maps x three own doctrines x three opposing doctrines x two pick orders; 83 drafts examined; no combat outcomes
registration.draftIntervention: At each legal L4 retry, abomination chooses offered 41. Alternative retains the exact native choice if not 41, otherwise uses the frozen base head on the remaining offer. Hidden collisions remain ordinary retries and may prevent acquiring Abomination. No hidden identities or future offers enter either choice.
registration.guard: Existing per-seat V08_ABOMINATION_GUARD=1 contract, including its existing dominant-finish release; no altered threshold. Opponent remains default.
registration.formation: After native final placement and before native barrels, greedily maximize exact Flesh Shield coverage of own live ranged/caster value. Enumerate legal own Abomination anchors; allocate wards by existing stable ward value; minimize relocation on ties; preserve baseline unless coverage strictly improves. Other allies remain fixed. Retain all augments, splits, artifacts and enemy native placement. Absent Abomination is a no-op.
registration.analysis: Draw=0.5. Mean paired difference over both seats within each independent draft family. 20,000 fixed-seed whole-family bootstrap samples. Report ordinary 95% and Bonferroni simultaneous 95% intervals for five planned contrasts. No pooled seat independence.
registration.subgroups: Descriptive only: own two-or-more ranged/caster creatures; visible opposing ranged count zero/one/two-plus; visible magic-damage capability yes/no; complete opposing roster magic/ranged for retrospective mechanism only; doctrine/map/pick order. No outcome-selected dispatch or subgroup promotion.
registration.quality: Source/registration hash checks, native setup funding and placement validation, same opening for guard comparisons, unchanged opponent opening for formation comparison, zero rejected actions/neural errors and valid health ledgers. Two-seat six-arm smoke repeats excluded from inference; 18 cross-host cold repeats on families 0,18,36 seat0 after completion. Preserve all failures.
registration.continuation: No automatic promotion or tuning on this bank. A positive screen motivates a separately registered fresh confirmation against current default; favorable shield HP or subgroup alone cannot qualify.

reservedChannelExpansion: For each preimage reserve raw seed+i and permuteRankedDraftSeed(seed+i), i=0..31, including rejected/unused; see allocate-seeds.py.

from pathlib import Path
import json,gzip,hashlib,random,collections
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
read=lambda p:json.loads(gzip.decompress(p.read_bytes())if p.name.endswith('.gz')else p.read_bytes())
reg=read(P/'registration.json');cases=read(P/'cases.json');modes=reg['arms'];rows={};summaries=[]
def walk(o):
 if isinstance(o,dict):
  if o.get('source')=='flesh_shield':yield o
  for v in o.values():yield from walk(v)
 elif isinstance(o,list):
  for v in o:yield from walk(v)
for task in cases:
 for seat in [0,1]:
  for mode in modes:
   p=P/'screen'/f"{task['id']}-s{seat}-{mode}.json.gz";r=read(p)
   rec=read(Path(str(p)+'.receipt'));raw=gzip.decompress(p.read_bytes())
   assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==rec['rawSha256'] and hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==rec['sha256']
   assert r['qualityPassed'] and r['score']in[0,.5,1]
   rows[task['id'],seat,mode]=r
   summaries.append({'id':task['id'],'seat':seat,'mode':mode,'score':r['score'],'elapsedMs':r['elapsedMs'],'abominationAcquired':any(u['creatureName']=='Abomination'for u in r['drafted']['config']['roster'if r['drafted']['candidateTeam']==2 else'redRoster']),
    'shieldDamage':sum(x.get('amount',0)for e in r['events']for x in walk(e)),
    'nativeChoice':task['offer']['native'],'knownRanged':sum(bool(i['ranged'])for i in task['knownEnemyInfo']),'knownMagic':any(i.get('dealsMagicDamage')for i in task['knownEnemyInfo']),
    'ownWards':sum(bool(i['ranged']or i['caster'])for i in task['ownPublicInfo'])})
score=lambda r:r['score']
family=lambda a,b:[sum(score(rows[t['id'],s,a])-score(rows[t['id'],s,b])for s in[0,1])/2 for t in cases]
rng=random.Random(17112026);draws=[[rng.randrange(len(cases))for _ in cases]for _ in range(20000)]
def interval(values,alpha):
 boot=sorted(sum(values[i]for i in draw)/len(values)*100 for draw in draws)
 return[boot[int(len(boot)*alpha/2)],boot[min(len(boot)-1,int(len(boot)*(1-alpha/2)))]]
contrasts=[]
for a,b in reg['primaryContrasts']:
 v=family(a,b);contrasts.append({'candidate':a,'control':b,'gainPp':sum(v)/len(v)*100,'ci95':interval(v,.05),'simultaneous95':interval(v,.05/5),
 'betterCases':sum(rows[t['id'],s,a]['score']>rows[t['id'],s,b]['score']for t in cases for s in[0,1]),'worseCases':sum(rows[t['id'],s,a]['score']<rows[t['id'],s,b]['score']for t in cases for s in[0,1])})
armStats={m:dict(collections.Counter(str(x['score'])for x in summaries if x['mode']==m))for m in modes}
subgroups=[]
for label,pred in [('known-ranged-0',lambda t:sum(i['ranged']for i in t['knownEnemyInfo'])==0),('known-ranged-1',lambda t:sum(i['ranged']for i in t['knownEnemyInfo'])==1),('known-ranged-2plus',lambda t:sum(i['ranged']for i in t['knownEnemyInfo'])>=2),('known-magic',lambda t:any(i.get('dealsMagicDamage')for i in t['knownEnemyInfo'])),('no-known-magic',lambda t:not any(i.get('dealsMagicDamage')for i in t['knownEnemyInfo'])),('own-2plus-wards',lambda t:sum(i['ranged']or i['caster']for i in t['ownPublicInfo'])>=2)]:
 idx=[i for i,t in enumerate(cases)if pred(t)]
 subgroups.append({'label':label,'families':len(idx),'exploratory':True,'gainsPp':{a+'--'+b:sum(family(a,b)[i]for i in idx)/len(idx)*100 if idx else None for a,b in reg['primaryContrasts']}})
out={'qualityPassed':True,'families':len(cases),'battles':len(summaries),'arms':armStats,'contrasts':contrasts,'subgroups':subgroups,'rows':summaries,'promotion':False}
with(P/'analysis.json').open('x')as f:json.dump(out,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in out.items()if k not in['rows','subgroups']},indent=2))
